command: set -eu; adb start-server >/dev/null; serial="$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}')"; test -n "$serial"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; adb -s "$serial" install -r -d app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb -s "$serial" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 7; pid="$(adb -s "$serial" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$pid"; errors="$(adb -s "$serial" logcat -d -v brief -t 1200 | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime: FATAL|io\.blueeye.*FATAL' || true)"; test -z "$errors"; echo V85_DEVICE_SMOKE_OK:$model:pid=$pid
